## Summary

Describe the problem, the outcome, and the user or developer experience affected by this change.

## Change type

- [ ] Component or styling
- [ ] Contract, schema, registry, or renderer
- [ ] Tooling, build, or test infrastructure
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Breaking change (migration notes included)

## What changed

- Describe the primary implementation change.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their outcomes.

```text
corepack pnpm ...
```

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the owning package and respects dependency boundaries.
- [ ] Public API, schema, registry, generated artifacts, stories, and tests are synchronized where applicable.
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, semantics, responsive layout, themes, density, high contrast, and forced colors were considered.
- [ ] Host authorization and side-effect boundaries remain explicit; untrusted inputs still fail closed.
- [ ] The root README and affected package or application READMEs are accurate.
- [ ] The change follows `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CODING_STANDARDS.md`, and the proprietary license; new third-party material has compatible terms.
- [ ] No credentials, generated build output, publication, or unrelated changes are included.

## Visual evidence

Add screenshots, recordings, or Storybook links for visible changes. Write “Not applicable” when the change has no visual impact.

## Follow-up or release notes

Document deferred work, compatibility considerations, or release notes. Write “None” when there are no follow-ups.
